_comment: Configuration for commit-and-tag-version, passed with --config by .scripts/release.mjs. It reads the current version from packageFiles, works out the bump from the Conventional Commits since the last tag, writes it to every bumpFiles entry, updates CHANGELOG.md, commits 'chore(release): x.y.z' and tags v<x.y.z>. app/Resources/Info.plist is the one place the version is set; the rest are generated copies (this repo's npm package, its lockfile, and the copy the website imports), and .scripts/version.mjs --check verifies they agree before CI releases or deploys.
_updater: Info.plist is not a format the tool knows, so these entries name a module that teaches it one key. The tool require()s that path and calls readVersion/writeVersion on it, which is why the plist logic lives in .scripts/plist-version.mjs: .scripts/version.mjs imports the same module, so a release and a bump by hand cannot drift apart.
